title: Premium Black Marble Tile
description: High-end black marble tile with elegant veining
longDescription: This premium black marble tile offers a bold and luxurious aesthetic with its deep black base and natural white veining. The polished finish enhances its reflective quality, making spaces appear larger and more elegant. Ideal for living rooms, hotel lobbies, and feature walls, it delivers both durability and timeless beauty. Easy to clean and maintain, it is perfect for high-end interior applications.

title: Italian White Carrara Marble
description: Classic Italian Carrara marble with soft gray veins
longDescription: Italian Carrara marble is world-renowned for its elegance and subtle beauty. This tile features a soft white background with gentle gray veining, making it perfect for bathrooms, kitchens, and luxury interiors. Its honed finish provides a smooth, matte surface that feels refined and modern. Highly versatile, it pairs well with both contemporary and classic design styles.

title: Matte Grey Porcelain Tile
description: Modern matte grey porcelain with stone texture
longDescription: This matte grey porcelain tile combines modern design with exceptional durability. Inspired by natural stone, it provides a sophisticated textured look without the maintenance concerns of real stone. It is resistant to stains, scratches, and moisture, making it ideal for kitchens, bathrooms, and commercial spaces. Its large format design also minimizes grout lines for a seamless appearance.

title: Beige Travertine Natural Stone
description: Warm beige travertine with natural variation
longDescription: Beige travertine tiles bring a natural and earthy feel to any space. Known for their unique textures and subtle variations, these tiles create a warm and inviting atmosphere. The tumbled finish adds a rustic touch, making them suitable for both indoor and outdoor applications such as patios, hallways, and living areas.

title: Polished White Ceramic Tile
description: Glossy white ceramic tile for bright spaces
longDescription: This polished white ceramic tile is perfect for creating bright, clean, and modern interiors. Its glossy surface reflects light beautifully, making smaller rooms appear more spacious. Easy to install and maintain, it is an excellent choice for kitchens, bathrooms, and walls.
